name: Livi & Rae's Room
body:
ADJACENT TO THE GYM, with Library Tower access a short walk away. Made for late study sessions and recovery — stacks of books and scattered notebooks sharing floor space with a rolled training mat and candle jars safely contained on the desk.

STICKY NOTES COVER EVERY SURFACE: Rae's messy poems bleeding into the margins of Livi's carefully drawn charts. A vase of wildflowers sits by the bed, replaced weekly without fail, and NEITHER OF THEM WILL SAY WHO STARTED THE TRADITION.

Reinforced timber four-poster. Bolted bookshelves. A walk-in closet shared between gym bags and poetry notebooks. Livi is 6'0.5"; Rae is 5'9.5", and folds into her anyway.
